```{r}
##Code to load SimpleLichen data
files <- list.files(path="//wsl.localhost/Ubuntu/home/teije/ALICEFOLDER/SimpleLichen/CelAut2011-1/examples/SpatialCorrelation", pattern="*.txt", full.names=TRUE, recursive=FALSE)
offset<-26
time<-NULL
Diff<-NULL
ASymbiotic<-NULL
FSymbiotic<-NULL
PSymbiotic<-NULL
ASolo<-NULL
FSolo<-NULL
PSolo<-NULL
ADeath<-NULL
FDeath<-NULL
PDeath<-NULL
seed<-NULL
files<-gsub("-1000000-", "-99-", files)
for(i in files){
  seed<-c(seed, substr(i, 75+offset, 75+offset))
  if(!grepl("-100000-", i)){
    time<-c(time, substr(i, 77+offset, 81+offset))
    if(!(grepl("-4-", i))& !(grepl("-7-", i))){
      Diff<-c(Diff, substr(i, 83+offset, 84+offset))
      ASymbiotic<-c(ASymbiotic, substr(i,86+offset,93+offset))
      FSymbiotic<-c(FSymbiotic, substr(i,95+offset,102+offset))
      PSymbiotic<-c(PSymbiotic, substr(i,104+offset,111+offset))
      ASolo<-c(ASolo, substr(i,113+offset,120+offset))
      FSolo<-c(FSolo, substr(i,122+offset,129+offset))
      PSolo<-c(PSolo, substr(i,131+offset,138+offset))
      ADeath<-c(ADeath, substr(i,140+offset,147+offset))
      FDeath<-c(FDeath, substr(i,149+offset,156+offset))
      PDeath<-c(PDeath, substr(i,158+offset,165+offset))
    }
    else{
      Diff<-c(Diff, substr(i, 83+offset, 83+offset))
      ASymbiotic<-c(ASymbiotic, substr(i,85+offset,92+offset))
      FSymbiotic<-c(FSymbiotic, substr(i,94+offset,101+offset))
      PSymbiotic<-c(PSymbiotic, substr(i,103+offset,110+offset))
      ASolo<-c(ASolo, substr(i,112+offset,119+offset))
      FSolo<-c(FSolo, substr(i,121+offset,128+offset))
      PSolo<-c(PSolo, substr(i,130+offset,137+offset))
      ADeath<-c(ADeath, substr(i,139+offset,146+offset))
      FDeath<-c(FDeath, substr(i,148+offset,155+offset))
      PDeath<-c(PDeath, substr(i,157+offset,164+offset))
    }
  }
  else{
    time<-c(time, substr(i, 77+offset, 82+offset))
    if(!grepl("-4-", i)& !grepl("-7-", i)){
      Diff<-c(Diff, substr(i, 84+offset, 85+offset))
      ASymbiotic<-c(ASymbiotic, substr(i,87+offset,94+offset))
      FSymbiotic<-c(FSymbiotic, substr(i,96+offset,103+offset))
      PSymbiotic<-c(PSymbiotic, substr(i,105+offset,112+offset))
      ASolo<-c(ASolo, substr(i,114+offset,121+offset))
      FSolo<-c(FSolo, substr(i,123+offset,130+offset))
      PSolo<-c(PSolo, substr(i,132+offset,139+offset))
      ADeath<-c(ADeath, substr(i,141+offset,148+offset))
      FDeath<-c(FDeath, substr(i,150+offset,157+offset))
      PDeath<-c(PDeath, substr(i,159+offset,166+offset))
    }
    else{
      Diff<-c(Diff, substr(i, 84+offset, 84+offset))
      ASymbiotic<-c(ASymbiotic, substr(i,86+offset,93+offset))
      FSymbiotic<-c(FSymbiotic, substr(i,95+offset,102+offset))
      PSymbiotic<-c(PSymbiotic, substr(i,104+offset,111+offset))
      ASolo<-c(ASolo, substr(i,113+offset,120+offset))
      FSolo<-c(FSolo, substr(i,122+offset,129+offset))
      PSolo<-c(PSolo, substr(i,131+offset,138+offset))
      ADeath<-c(ADeath, substr(i,140+offset,147+offset))
      FDeath<-c(FDeath, substr(i,149+offset,156+offset))
      PDeath<-c(PDeath, substr(i,158+offset,165+offset))
    }
  }
  
}
files<-gsub("-99-", "-1000000-", files)
as.numeric(time)->time
as.numeric(Diff)->Diff
as.numeric(ASymbiotic)->ASymbiotic
as.numeric(FSymbiotic)->FSymbiotic
as.numeric(PSymbiotic)->PSymbiotic
as.numeric(ASolo)->ASolo
as.numeric(FSolo)->FSolo
as.numeric(PSolo)->PSolo
as.numeric(ADeath)->ADeath
as.numeric(FDeath)->FDeath
as.numeric(PDeath)->PDeath
data.frame(seed, time, Diff, ASymbiotic, FSymbiotic, PSymbiotic, ASolo, FSolo, PSolo, ADeath, FDeath, PDeath)->ksiFrame
ksiMIN<-NULL
ksiMAX<-NULL
for(i in files){
  output<-read.csv(i, header=FALSE)
  if(!is.na(output[3])){
  c(ksiMIN,output$V1)->ksiMIN
  c(ksiMAX,output$V2)->ksiMAX
  }
  else{
    c(ksiMIN,NA)->ksiMIN
    c(ksiMAX,NA)->ksiMAX
  }
}
ksiFrame<-cbind(ksiFrame, data.frame(ksiMIN, ksiMAX))
ksiFrame<-subset(ksiFrame, !is.na(ksiFrame$ksiMIN))
ksiFrame<-subset(ksiFrame, ksiFrame$ksiMIN>0)
ksiFrameDeath<-subset(ksiFrame, ksiFrame$Diff==10 &ksiFrame$ASymbiotic==0.1 & ksiFrame$FSymbiotic==0.1)
ksiFrameDvP<-subset(ksiFrame, ksiFrame$ASymbiotic==0.1 & ksiFrame$FSymbiotic==0.1 & ksiFrame$FDeath==0.008 & ksiFrame$ADeath==0.008)
ksiFrameAvF<-subset(ksiFrame, ksiFrame$Diff==10 & ksiFrame$PSymbiotic==0.2 &ksiFrame$FDeath==0.008 & ksiFrame$ADeath==0.008)
```

Loading complete, now we plot heatmaps
```{r}
##General bookkeeping stuff
num_colors <- 128
colors <- heat.colors(num_colors)
colors <- c("black", colors)  # Add black for NA values

# Create a custom function to handle NA values
custom_col <- function(x) {
  ifelse(is.na(x), 1, x+1)
}
library(fields)
```

```{r}
##SimpleLichen heatmapping print to file
uniqueDiff<-sort(unique(ksiFrameDvP$Diff))
uniquePsym<-sort(unique(ksiFrameDvP$PSymbiotic))
DvP<-array(as.numeric(c(1:5)),dim=c(length(unique(ksiFrameDvP$Diff)),length(unique(ksiFrameDvP$PSymbiotic))))
for(i in c(1:length(uniqueDiff))){
  for(j in c(1:length(uniquePsym))){
    DvP[i,j]<-median(subset(ksiFrameDvP, ksiFrameDvP$Diff==uniqueDiff[i] & ksiFrameDvP$PSymbiotic==uniquePsym[j] & ksiFrameDvP$time==10000)[,13])
  }
}
output_file <- "heatmapDvPS.png"
png(filename = output_file, width = 800, height = 600)
image.plot(1:length(uniquePsym), 1:length(uniqueDiff), custom_col(t(DvP)),
           xlab = "",
           ylab = "",
           col = colors,
           axis.args = list(at = seq(min(DvP, na.rm = TRUE), max(DvP, na.rm = TRUE), length.out = 5), labels = round(seq(min(DvP, na.rm = TRUE), max(DvP, na.rm = TRUE), length.out = 5), 2)), axes=FALSE)
title(main = "Interaction Distance as a function
      of Parasitic Growth rate and Diffusion", cex.main=1.5)
mtext(side = 1, text = "Probability of parasite reproduction", line = 4, cex = 1.8)  # Adjust 'line' to move x-axis title down
mtext(side = 2, text = "1/rate of diffusion", line = 2.5, cex = 1.8)  # Adjust 'line' to move y-axis title right
axis(1, at = 1:length(uniquePsym), labels = uniquePsym, las = 2, cex.axis=1.5)
axis(2, at = 1:length(uniqueDiff), labels = uniqueDiff, las = 2, cex.axis=1.5)
box()
dev.off()

uniqueAg<-sort(unique(ksiFrameAvF$ASymbiotic))
uniqueFg<-sort(unique(ksiFrameAvF$FSymbiotic))
AvF<-array(as.numeric(c(1:10)),dim=c(length(unique(ksiFrameAvF$ASymbiotic)),length(unique(ksiFrameAvF$FSymbiotic))))
for(i in c(1:length(uniqueAg))){
  for(j in c(1:length(uniqueFg))){
    AvF[i,j]<-median(subset(ksiFrameAvF, ksiFrameAvF$ASymbiotic==uniqueAg[i] & ksiFrameAvF$FSymbiotic==uniqueFg[j]& ksiFrameAvF$time==10000)[,13])
  }
}
output_file <- "heatmapAvFS.png"
png(filename = output_file, width = 800, height = 600)
par(mar=c(8,8,3,3))
image.plot(1:length(uniqueFg), 1:length(uniqueAg), custom_col(t(AvF)),
           xlab = "", 
           ylab = "",
           col = colors,
           axis.args = list(at = seq(min(AvF, na.rm = TRUE), max(AvF, na.rm = TRUE), length.out = 5), labels = round(seq(min(AvF, na.rm = TRUE), max(AvF, na.rm = TRUE), length.out = 5), 2)), axes=FALSE)
title(main = "Interaction Distance as a function
      of Fungal and Algal Symbiotic Growth Rate", cex.main=1.5)
mtext(side = 1, text = "Probability of Fungal Reproduction next to Algal cell", line = 6, cex = 1.5)  # Adjust 'line' to move x-axis title down
mtext(side = 2, text = "Probability of Algal Reproduction next to Fungal cell", line = 6, cex = 1.5)  # Adjust 'line' to move y-axis title right
axis(1, at = 1:length(uniqueFg), labels = uniqueFg, las = 2, cex.axis=1.5)
axis(2, at = 1:length(uniqueAg), labels = uniqueAg, las = 2, cex.axis=1.5)
box()
dev.off()

uniqueDeath<-sort(unique(ksiFrameDeath$ADeath))
uniquePsym2<-sort(unique(ksiFrameDeath$PSymbiotic))
Death<-array(as.numeric(c(1:5)),dim=c(length(unique(ksiFrameDeath$ADeath)),length(unique(ksiFrameDeath$PSymbiotic))))
for(i in c(1:length(uniqueDeath))){
  for(j in c(1:length(uniquePsym2))){
    Death[i,j]<-median(subset(ksiFrameDeath, ksiFrameDeath$ADeath==uniqueDeath[i] & ksiFrameDeath$PSymbiotic==uniquePsym2[j]& ksiFrameDeath$time==10000)[,13])
  }
}
output_file <- "heatmapDeathS.png"
png(filename = output_file, width = 800, height = 600)
par(mar=c(8,8,3,3))
image.plot(1:length(uniquePsym2), 1:length(uniqueDeath), custom_col(t(Death)),
           xlab = "", 
           ylab = "",
           col = colors,
           axis.args = list(at = seq(min(Death, na.rm = TRUE), max(Death, na.rm = TRUE), length.out = 5),  labels = round(seq(min(Death, na.rm = TRUE), max(Death, na.rm = TRUE), length.out = 5), 2)), axes = FALSE)
mtext(side = 1, text = "Probability of parasite reproduction", line = 4, cex = 1.8)  # Adjust 'line' to move x-axis title down
mtext(side = 2, text = "Probability of Algal Death Rate", line = 4, cex = 1.8)  # Adjust 'line' to move y-axis title right
title(main = "Interaction Distance as a function of Death Rate 
      of Algal cells vs Parasitic Growth Rate", cex.main=1.5)
axis(1, at = 1:length(uniquePsym2), labels = uniquePsym2, las = 2, cex.axis=1.5)
axis(2, at = 1:length(uniqueDeath), labels = uniqueDeath, las = 2, cex.axis=1.5)
box()
dev.off()
```

```{r}
##SimpleLichen
# Loop through each unique value and create a plot: Psym in DvP
for (i in 1:length(uniquePsym)) {
  dummyframe <- subset(ksiFrameDvP, 
                       PSymbiotic == uniquePsym[i] &
                       ADeath == 0.008 &
                       FDeath == 0.008 &
                       ASymbiotic == 0.1 &
                       FSymbiotic == 0.1 &
                       time == 10000)
output_file <- paste("SDvP.Psym=", uniquePsym[i],".png")
png(filename = output_file, width = 800, height = 600)
par(mar=c(5,5,3,3))
  plot(dummyframe$Diff, dummyframe$ksiMIN,
       main = paste("Probability of Parasite reproduction =", uniquePsym[i]),
       xlab = "1/rate of diffusion",
       ylab = expression("lower bound of " * xi),
       cex.main = 3, cex = 2, cex.axis = 2, cex.lab = 2, col = "blue", type = "n")
  
  # Add boxplots
  medians <- numeric(length(uniqueDiff))
  colors <- character(length(uniqueDiff))
  
  for (j in 1:length(uniqueDiff)) {
    subset_data <- dummyframe$ksiMIN[dummyframe$Diff == uniqueDiff[j]]
    if (length(subset_data) > 0) {
      median_value <- median(subset_data)
      medians[j] <- median_value
      # Normalize the median value to a range [0, 1] for coloring (adjust as needed)
      norm_median <- (median_value - min(ksiFrameDvP$ksiMIN)) / (max(ksiFrameDvP$ksiMIN) - min(ksiFrameDvP$ksiMIN))
      # Use a color ramp to get colors based on the median value
      box_color <- rgb(1 - norm_median, 0, norm_median, 0.5)
      colors[j] <- box_color
      boxplot(subset_data, add = TRUE, at = uniqueDiff[j], axes = FALSE, col = box_color, boxwex = 5)  # Increase box width with boxwex
    }
  }
  
  # Add a legend
  color_legend <- colorRampPalette(c("red", "purple"))(10)
  legend("topright", legend = round(seq(min(dummyframe$ksiMIN), max(dummyframe$ksiMIN), length.out = 10), 2), 
         fill = color_legend, title = "Median Value")
  dev.off()
}
```
